user.title: Add Microsoft Teams Workflow Notify
user.description: Connect a Power Automate workflow created with the Teams 'When a Teams webhook request is received' trigger. Setup sends one visible verification card.

data_description.webhook_url: The secret HTTPS callback URL copied from the saved workflow.
data_description.entity_name: A friendly name for this Teams channel connection.
data_description.default_card_title: Used when an action does not provide a title.
data_description.full_width: Ask the Teams renderer to use the full message width.

reconfigure.title: Change webhook URL
reconfigure.description: Replace the webhook URL. Home Assistant sends one visible verification card before saving it.

data_description.webhook_url: The new secret HTTPS callback URL copied from the saved workflow.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The workflow rejected a request. Enter a current webhook URL; Home Assistant sends one visible verification card before saving it.

data_description.webhook_url: The replacement secret HTTPS callback URL copied from the saved workflow.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS webhook URL without embedded credentials or a fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The workflow rejected the verification request. Confirm that its trigger authentication is set to Anyone and copy a current URL.
error.cannot_connect: The workflow could not be reached or did not accept the request.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while verifying the workflow.

abort.already_configured: This webhook URL is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The workflow connection was updated successfully.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The webhook URL was updated successfully.

init.title: Configure Microsoft Teams Workflow Notify
init.description: Change the connection name and default Adaptive Card presentation. Use Reconfigure on the integration entry to replace the webhook URL.

data_description.entity_name: A friendly name for this Teams channel connection.
data_description.default_card_title: Used when an action does not provide a title.
data_description.full_width: Ask the Teams renderer to use the full message width.

send_card.name: Send adaptive card
send_card.description: Send a rich Adaptive Card through a configured Microsoft Teams workflow.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional card title. The configured default is used when omitted.

message.name: Message
message.description: Main message body to include in the Adaptive Card.

subtitle.name: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Optional subtle text shown above the title.

severity.name: Severity
severity.description: Visual severity style for the card title.

facts.name: Facts
facts.description: Optional list of title and value objects rendered as a FactSet.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Optional list of up to six title and URL objects rendered as open-link buttons.

image_url.name: Image source
image_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL, Base64 data URI, /local/ URL, or file path inside Home Assistant's www directory for a PNG, JPEG, or GIF image.

image_delivery.name: Image delivery
image_delivery.description: Auto uses Home Assistant's external HTTPS URL for compatible local images and otherwise embeds an optimized copy. URL requires external HTTPS access and a Teams-compatible local image; inline always embeds a normalized image.

image_alt_text.name: Image alternative text
image_alt_text.description: Optional accessible description of the image. The card title is used when omitted.

authentication_failed.message: The Microsoft Teams workflow rejected the request. Reconfigure the integration with a current webhook URL.

connection_error.message: Home Assistant could not reach the Microsoft Teams workflow.

invalid_message.message: The notification message must not be empty.

invalid_image.message: The card image is missing, unsupported, outside Home Assistant's www directory, or cannot be safely used.

image_too_large.message: The card image could not be reduced enough to fit within the Microsoft Teams message-size limit. Shorten the card text or use an externally accessible image URL.

external_image_url_unavailable.message: Home Assistant does not have a configured external HTTPS or cloud URL for this local image. Use automatic or inline image delivery, or configure secure remote access.

invalid_webhook_url.message: The stored Microsoft Teams workflow URL is invalid. Reconfigure the integration.

payload_too_large.message: The Adaptive Card payload is {size} bytes, exceeding the Microsoft Teams connector limit of {limit} bytes.

response_error.message: The Microsoft Teams workflow returned HTTP status {status}.

send_failed.message: The Microsoft Teams workflow notification could not be sent.
